name: net_twilight_thorn_reactions
description: Short post09 exact-trimmed-DLL, single-PC loopback proof through the same FM00 real doors: all opening297/298/299, actual ground345/432 owner0 and owner1 completion; owner1 joins host offer/client consume-once local queued1/host complete by exact immutable tuple. Stop BOTH existing pad pilots at the milestone or any abort, neutral release, finalize active paired30s clips, then clean owned teardown. No full kill attempt, warps, forced death, protection or synthetic state. Session1 existing Game.state read-only observations at about10Hz retain qualified/raw/source/prompt fields; no new input object.
qualificationGaps: This short RC proof is not full kill, mission4/16, event315, survival, child317 parity or two-PC acceptance.
Capture is paired30s blocks with encoder/handoff gaps; actions logged in a gap are not automatically filmed. Active clip may have a neutral tail after pilot stop.
Root must use the exact reviewed trimmed DLL containing consume-once local completion queued logging in both branches; new scenario alone cannot attest product identity.
Read-only Game.state runs in Session1 on exact context-owned PID handles; raw fallback/unavailable prompt telemetry is recorded honestly, not relabeled qualified.

Read-only host307 HP floor128 is checked with the1s native guard and at goal/afterneutralclip tail; missing/excess boss rows refuse. This coarse sampled floor reduces kill drift but is not an atomic no-kill guarantee.

steps.until: ([{'opening':opening,'groundHost':host,'groundFriend':friend,'clientQueued':local,'identity':saved['rc_identity']} for offers in [log_matches(saved['rc_patterns']['offer'],0)[saved['rc_baseline']['offer']:]] for completed in [log_matches(saved['rc_patterns']['complete'],0)[saved['rc_baseline']['complete']:]] for locals_ in [log_matches(saved['rc_patterns']['local'],1)[saved['rc_baseline']['local']:]] for opening in [[c for c in completed if c['command'] in ('297','298','299') and c['source']==saved['rc_identity']['source'] and any(o['epoch']==saved['rc_identity']['epoch'] and all(c[k]==o[k] for k in ('source','resource','occurrence','command','owner')) for o in offers)]] if {c['command'] for c in opening}=={'297','298','299'} for host in completed if host['command'] in ('345','432') and host['owner']=='0' and host['source']==saved['rc_identity']['source'] and any(o['epoch']==saved['rc_identity']['epoch'] and all(host[k]==o[k] for k in ('source','resource','occurrence','command','owner')) for o in offers) for friend in completed if friend['command'] in ('345','432') and friend['owner']=='1' and friend['source']==saved['rc_identity']['source'] and any(o['epoch']==saved['rc_identity']['epoch'] and all(friend[k]==o[k] for k in ('source','resource','occurrence','command','owner')) for o in offers) for local in locals_ if local['queued']=='1' and all(friend[k]==local[k] for k in ('source','resource','occurrence','command','owner'))] or [False])[0]
